payload.content:
name: dependent-declarations-family
nodes:
  sync:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
  sensor:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1073741824
      cpu: 1
    os: linux
infrastructure:
  sync:
    count: 1
  sensor:
    count: 1
persistent_volumes:
  rules:
    lifecycle: ephemeral
    access_mode: read_write_many
    consumers:
    - node: sensor
      mount_destination: /var/lib/rules
      access_mode: read_only
    - node: sync
      mount_destination: /var/lib/rules
      access_mode: read_write
accounts:
  sync-api:
    username: sync
    node: sync
variation_points:
  sync-host:
    kind: alternative
    target:
      kind: structural
      owner: sync
      slot: nodes.presence
    alternatives:
      absent:
        requires:
        - point: sync-account
          members:
          - absent
        - point: shared-mounts
          members:
          - without-sync
        kind: node-presence
        present: false
      present:
        kind: node-presence
        present: true
  sync-account:
    kind: alternative
    target:
      kind: structural
      owner: sync-api
      slot: accounts.presence
    alternatives:
      absent:
        kind: declaration-presence
        present: false
      present:
        requires:
        - point: sync-host
          members:
          - present
        kind: declaration-presence
        present: true
  shared-mounts:
    kind: alternative
    target:
      kind: structural
      owner: rules
      slot: persistent_volumes.consumers
    alternatives:
      without-sync:
        kind: resource-consumers
        consumers:
        - node: sensor
          mount_destination: /var/lib/rules
      all:
        requires:
        - point: sync-host
          members:
          - present
        kind: resource-consumers
        consumers:
        - node: sensor
          mount_destination: /var/lib/rules
        - node: sync
          mount_destination: /var/lib/rules
